intended_behavior: Implement BudgetControlMiddleware subclassing MiddlewareBase that overrides the async generator method on_reasoning. This method will accumulate total token usage from Msg usage attributes before each reasoning step, check if the token usage exceeds a configured max_tokens limit, and if so, inject an appropriate hint message instructing the agent to immediately conclude without invoking tools. Otherwise, it will yield normal reasoning events from next_handler as usual. This middleware will be intended to prevent runaway agents in scheduling contexts and ensure token budget enforcement.
